text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: surge of container restarts (20+) for deployment inference-runtime-prod in us-east-1. Error pattern: SIGSEGV in custom_quant_kernels.so. Paging oncall @lina. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2055550000
PagerDuty: Paging Lina Gomez (oncall) — please acknowledge.
Lina Gomez: Ack. I'm pulling pod list and logs now.
Lina Gomez: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-runtime -o wide` -> many pods with RESTARTS 4-18; majority pinned to node gpu-a100-12.
SRE Lead: Are there recent deploys? Deploy Bot: Canary rti-runtime:v3.3.0-quant promoted 12m ago.
Omar Reyes: grabbing container logs from a pod that just crashed. Tail shows:
```
[rt-engine] allocator: allocating 128MB
[rt-engine] kv_cache: writing 32MB
[quant_kernel] memcpy: copying 64MB
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```
Lina Gomez: interesting: bad_alloc then segfault — looks like allocator/quant kernel interplay.
ML Infra: pulling node dmesg: `GPU hang detected - Xid 79` followed by `oom_reaper: reaped process` entries. Kernel not oopsing to driver, but userspace crash in custom_quant_kernels.so.
Support Lead: customer reports inbound: increased 500s and reconnects for chat endpoints in us-east-1 starting ~10:07 UTC. Notifying CS.
Lina Gomez: mitigation options: 1) cordon/drain gpu-a100-12, 2) set runtime flag `--quant-optimizations=off`, 3) rollback to v3.2.9. I'll cordon node and patch config to disable quant opt.
Lina Gomez: `kubectl cordon gpu-a100-12` -> success. `kubectl drain gpu-a100-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> in progress.
Lina Gomez: patching config: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-runtime QUANT_OPT=false` -> applied, issuing `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime`.
Deploy Bot: Rollout started for inference-runtime -> image pinned remains v3.3.0-quant but env QUANT_OPT=false.
Omar Reyes: after config flip, new pods are stable on other nodes. Crash counts on gpu-a100-12 tapering as pods drain.
Observability Bot: metrics update: error-rate from 13% -> 2.1% within 8m after mitigation. Latency 95p restored by ~10:20 UTC.
SRE Lead: leaving node cordoned. Schedule GPU mem/SM tests for 0200 UTC. Need to keep it out until clear.
Lina Gomez: capturing core: `gcore $(pidof inference-engine)` before restart; core archived to s3://incidents/2055550000/cores/core.quant. Also saved pod logs and allocator heap dump to s3.
Omar Reyes: gdb bt on core shows:
```
#0  0x7f5d2c in quant_kernel::run
#1  0x7f4c8a in fused_attention::execute
#2  0x55f2b in engine::process_batch
#3  0x5639f in kv_cache::write
#4  0x56810 in main_loop
```
Lina Gomez: backtrace implicates quant kernel memcpy and then a call into kv_cache::write — suspect double-free or use-after-free of buffer when quant path and kv flush run concurrently.
ML Infra: note that v3.3.0-quant introduced a lock elision optimization in allocator to reduce mutex contention. That could expose races where buffer lifetime is assumed longer than it actually is.
SRE Lead: short-term: keep QUANT_OPT=false cluster-wide and keep node cordoned. Start rollback to v3.2.9-prod for added safety.
Lina Gomez: `kubectl set image deployment/inference-runtime inference-runtime=rti-runtime:v3.2.9 -n inference` -> rolling back.
Deploy Bot: Rollback to v3.2.9 started.
Omar Reyes: after rollback + QUANT_OPT=false, no new segfaults observed; service stable.
Support Lead: Customer Success notified customers affected between 10:07-10:22 UTC. Ticket numbers created: CS-9921, CS-9922.
Lina Gomez: creating issue INF-4021 to track: "quant allocator race -> crashloop with custom_quant_kernels.so". Attaching core, logs, metrics, and reproduction notes. Assigning to @omar and @ml_infra.
ML Infra: next steps: (1) reproduce locally with stress harness that exercises concurrent kv writes + quant kernel runs, (2) revert lock elision or add explicit refcounting to buffers, (3) add canary gate that runs stress test for 15m on PRs touching allocator or quant kernels.
SRE Lead: follow-up also: add a health-check tweak so kubelet won't continuously restart a pod if it crashes with SIGSEGV more than 3x in 5m (soft backoff) to reduce churn during incidents.
Lina Gomez: handing off long-term debugging to Omar. I'll close the pager now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: Incident 2055550000 marked mitigated by config disable + rollback. Postmortem draft: https://incidents.redwood/postmortem/2055550000
Omar Reyes: taking ownership of INF-4021. Will post daily progress here and schedule a joint triage with allocator owners and research.
Support Lead: saved artifacts to s3://incidents/2055550000/ and notified affected customers.
Lina Gomez: last note: saved node diagnostics to gs://infra-diagnostics/2055550000/ and left node cordoned pending validation.
Observability Bot: summary metrics attached to incident archive: error-rate chart, pod restart histogram, top stack traces.
Omar Reyes: will follow up with a proposed patch by tomorrow. Please add any other items to INF-4021.
